test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 18

questions.question: A, B, and C invest in a business	A invests ₹24,000 for 6 months	B invests ₹30,000 for 8 months	C invests ₹18,000 for the entire year After 1 year, the total profit of the business is ₹1,50,000 How much profit does B receive? 481

A number, when divided by a divisor, leaves a remainder of 22. When twice the original number is divided by the same divisor, the remainder is 8. Which of the given options is the maximum value of the divisor?

If all the three working together can complete the job in 28 days, then find the number of days that Aman alone will take to finish the job.
